originals.citation: Berg, L., Miller, J. P., et al. (1988). Mild senile dementia of the Alzheimer type: 2. Longitudinal assessment. Annals of Neurology.

quote: This replication study confirmed our earlier conclusions that four of six clinical measures showed similar patterns over time and were useful throughout the study
notes: The earlier longitudinal study of 43 mild SDAT subjects is part 2 of the series; @berg1982 describes the study population/criteria.
